strategy.thesis: Allianz X is the digital investment unit of German insurer Allianz Group, backing growth-stage digital companies across mobility, connected property, connected health, wealth/retirement and cyber; its connected-health bets (e.g. a $59.2M strategic investment in telehealth platform American Well, plus BIMA and Halodoc) extend Allianz's insurance ecosystem into virtual care.

summary.en: Munich-based corporate venture arm of Allianz Group that invests in growth-stage digital companies in insurance-adjacent ecosystems, including connected health platforms such as American Well.

summary.en: Corporate venture arm of German reinsurer Munich Re, with a HealthTech investment vertical spanning digital health, virtual care and novel financing models for cell & gene therapy access.
